title: Platform settings
subtitle: Manage your organisation, who can use it, and how each module behaves.

groups.subtitle: Give the same access to several users, devices or applications at once.
groups.name: Name
groups.emptyHint: Create a group, then add members and give it access.
groups.deleteText: Its members lose the access the group gave them.

profile.subtitle: Your organisation's name and how dates, times and money are shown.

branding.subtitle: The colour and logo everyone in your organisation sees.
branding.primaryColorHelp: A hex colour such as #1f5fbf. Leave empty for the default.
branding.logoUrlHelp: Upload an image, or a path on this site.
branding.tooLarge: The logo must be smaller than {{size}} KB.

modules.subtitle: Settings of the platform's own services, such as billing. Each module's settings are in the module itself, under Settings in its menu.
modules.empty: None of the platform's services has settings.

features.subtitle: Optional features and whether they are on for your organisation. Ask your provider to change them.

support.subtitle: Requests from your provider's support team to look at your data. Nothing is shared without your approval.
support.approveText: {{operator}} will be able to act as {{role}} in {{module}} until {{expires}}.

feedback.subtitle: What your organisation's people have sent to your provider. Anyone signed in can send feedback from the top bar.

users.subtitle: People who can sign in, and what they can do in each module.
users.name: Name
users.emptyHint: Invite the people who should use the app.
users.inviteText: They'll get an email with a link to choose a password.
users.invitedNoEmail: The invitation was created, but the email could not be sent. Use Resend invitation.
users.rolesHint: What they can do in each module. Groups may give more.
users.deactivateText: They are signed out everywhere and can't sign in until you activate them again.
users.resentNoEmail: The new invitation was created, but the email could not be sent. Try Resend invitation again later.
users.effectiveHint: Direct roles and group roles combined, limited to what your plan includes.

devices.subtitle: Shared devices, such as a warehouse tablet. Each can hold access to modules, directly or through groups.
devices.codeText: Enter this code on the device within 15 minutes (until {{expires}}). It is shown only once: {{code}}

applications.subtitle: External systems, such as an ERP or a partner, that call the API. Each can hold access to modules, directly or through groups.
applications.addText: For an external system (an ERP, a partner) that calls the API with the client-credentials flow.
applications.secretText: Client ID: {{clientId}} · Secret: {{secret}} — copy the secret now; it is not shown again.

access.denied: You don't have access to this part of Settings.

audit.subtitle: Sign-ins, access changes and everything support staff did with support access. Kept for good; nothing can be changed.

activity.subtitle: Changes to your organisation's plan, modules, settings and support policy, by your admins and your provider.
